about_the_game:
This official soundtrack features 3 original Japanese tracks from Back from the Other World, I Missed Love — including 1 opening theme and 2 insert songs.
Each track beautifully captures the game’s most romantic and emotionally resonant moments, from energetic love-filled rhythms to soft inner monologues.
All songs are original compositions, crafted by a professional team to express a love story where magic and reality intertwine.
